entries.message: The review-learnings store has no entry-count or file-size bound: each first prompt load parses and maps every historical entry, and each append filters and rewrites the complete collection. The rendered prompt is capped at 20 entries, but parsing and serialization remain O(N) as the repo-owned history grows.
entries.guidance: The learnings file is repo-owned history. Prompt rendering is already capped and cached. Store compaction is not required for this issue.

entries.message: Violates acceptance criterion #9: on Linux, where the Cursor README says review lanes are supported, runModelReview calls watchModelReviewCheckout before resolving or launching the host. watchModelReviewCheckout unconditionally calls fs.watch(repoRoot, { recursive: true }); Node's recursive fs.watch support is not available on Linux, so this throws and the surrounding runModelReview catch returns model-route-unavailable instead of running the fresh Cursor lane. The concrete outcome is that every Linux routed review fails before Cursor invocation or provider publication.
entries.guidance: QUBE requires Node 24 or newer. Recursive fs.watch support on Linux was added in Node 19.1, and the ignored-directory monitor test exercises this path in Linux CI. Do not report Linux as unsupported unless the required Node engine is lowered or a current supported-runtime test fails.

entries.message: Rejected security finding: Codex shell_environment_policy.inherit=all does not inherit the QUBE parent environment. QUBE launches Codex with modelRouteEnvironment(), which retains only a fixed non-credential allowlist. The real-process test proves that GH_TOKEN and a parent sentinel are absent. Do not report an environment-secret leak unless the launch path stops applying that allowlist or the real-process test fails.
